integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect external studio tools and cloud services.

google.title: Google Workspace
google.description: Connect your studio's Google Workspace to synchronize client contacts for caller identification during shoot days.
google.unconfiguredAlertDescription: To enable Google Workspace integration, configure your studio's Google Cloud OAuth credentials and credential vault encryption key in your server environment.
google.step1Title: 1. Create Google Cloud Project & OAuth Client
google.step1Description: Create a project in the Google Cloud Console, enable the Google People API, and configure an OAuth 2.0 Web Application client.
google.step3Description: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY (32 random bytes), GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET in your .env file, then restart the studio server.
google.disconnectDialogDescription: Disconnecting will revoke Ownlight's access to your Google account and remove stored credentials from your server.
google.disconnectDeleteContactsLabel: Delete synced studio contacts from Google Contacts
google.disconnectDeleteContactsHint: Recommended. Contacts created by Ownlight will be removed from your Google account. Your local Ownlight client records remain intact.
google.successDisconnectedAlert: Google Workspace disconnected and credentials removed.
google.errorGeneric: An error occurred with the Google integration. Please try again.
google.errorUnconfigured: Google Workspace integration is not configured.
google.featureCallerIdDescription: Synchronizes names and phone numbers of clients with active shoots to your Google Contacts so incoming calls display client names.
google.privacyNoticeDescription: Ownlight only transmits client names and phone numbers when explicitly opted-in per client. Client email addresses, notes, contracts, and private studio data are never sent to Google.
google.syncFailedWarningDescription: One or more contacts could not be synchronized with Google Contacts. The sync worker will automatically retry, or you can update the contact to re-trigger sync.

archiveDialog.title: Archive Inquiry Form
archiveDialog.description: Are you sure you want to archive this inquiry form? Once archived, the form will no longer accept submissions or appear as published. Existing inquiries will not be lost.

shareEmbed.title: Share & embed
shareEmbed.description: Share your hosted inquiry page, embed it in an iframe, or generate a script-free HTML form.
shareEmbed.warningNoOrigins: Iframe embedding and HTML form POST are disabled because no embed origins are configured in PUBLIC_FORMS_EMBED_ORIGINS by the operator.
shareEmbed.hostedLinkHelp: Direct link to your public inquiry form.
shareEmbed.iframeHelp: Embed your inquiry form seamlessly on your photography website.
shareEmbed.htmlFormHelp: Pure HTML form for external websites that submits directly without JavaScript.
shareEmbed.successRedirectUrlHelp: Must be an https:// URL whose origin is in PUBLIC_FORMS_EMBED_ORIGINS.
